main_text.p: ter has Ecclesias ementiuntur, vera esse, nihilominus argumentorum momenta pro confensu adhuc sibi constant cum multo plura commemo-rentur, quibus distant a Refor-matis. Et nugatoria sunt, quae ex a-liorum testimonijs diducunt: Ridi-cule enim concluditur, hic vel ille dicit Græcos agere, vel dicere; Er-go Græci, vel Ecclesia Græca agit, & dicit. Quamuis etenim Græca Ecclesia ex Græcis consistat, non ideo tamen quidquid singuli Græ-ci dicunt, Ecclesiam Græcam dicere asseuerandum est. Nam in ea Ecclesia fuere & perditi animi ho-mines, & Hæretici, & Schisma-tici, & quid non ? Pestes tamen similes non infecerunt Ecclesiam, sicuti nec Occidentalem similes sortis homines. Et perridiculus es-

page.notes: The catchword "set" is read as the long-s form of "set" (completing "es-" as "esset"). Long s was normalised throughout (f read as s in confensu, consistat, sunt, similes, sortis, sibi, singuli, distant, es-). "fuere" was kept with f as a genuine Latin word, and the reading of its initial letter is uncertain. "asseuerandum" and "non ?" are copied as printed. The small mark at the left of the bottom line is not printed text and is left out.
